title: Less trade, less income
goal: Say how serious the crisis was, with superlatives such as *la peor crisis*.

items: I can say that something is the worst, the most or the least, with a superlative.
I can explain why less foreign trade meant less money for the State.
I can say which areas suffered most.
I can use the words *el ingreso*, *la divisa*, *la importación* and *el libre comercio*.
